name: US–China / Taiwan
value: Area-denial drills; APEC Shenzhen next week
summary: Taiwan said on 10 Nov China is running area-denial drills in the Western Pacific; Trump and Xi expected at APEC
state: Taiwan's defence minister Wellington Koo said on 10 Nov that China is conducting area-denial drills in the Western Pacific involving the Liaoning carrier group, after Taiwan reported more than 100 Chinese naval and coast guard ships in the region the week before (Taipei Times, Reuters; ThePrint). China has not declared any drills. The activity precedes the APEC summit in Shenzhen, where Presidents Trump and Xi are expected. No blockade, clash or severed channel was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Large-scale Chinese naval activity raises the risk of incidents near Taiwan and on shipping routes through the region. Travellers can follow FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China for any change.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan (Liaoning group area-denial drills, 10 Nov) = Watch; no blockade or clash
